verses.he: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ׀ הַ֭לְלוּ עַבְדֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה הַֽ֝לְלוּ אֶת־שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָֽה׃
verses.en: Hallelujah. Praise, O ye servants of HaShem, praise the name of HaShem.

verses.he: יְהִ֤י שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֣ה מְבֹרָ֑ךְ מֵֽ֝עַתָּ֗ה וְעַד־עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.en: Blessed be the name of the LORD From this time forth and for ever.
From the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof The LORD'S name is to be praised.

verses.he: רָ֖ם עַל־כָּל־גּוֹיִ֥ם׀ יְהוָ֑ה עַ֖ל הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם כְּבוֹדֽוֹ׃
verses.en: The LORD is high above all nations, His glory is above the heavens.
Who is like unto the LORD our God, That is enthroned on high,
That looketh down low Upon heaven and upon the earth?

verses.he: מְקִֽימִ֣י מֵעָפָ֣ר דָּ֑ל מֵֽ֝אַשְׁפֹּ֗ת יָרִ֥ים אֶבְיֽוֹן׃
verses.en: Who raiseth up the poor out of the dust, And lifteth up the needy out of the dunghill;
That He may set him with princes, Even with the princes of His people.

verses.he: מֽוֹשִׁיבִ֨י׀ עֲקֶ֬רֶת הַבַּ֗יִת אֵֽם־הַבָּנִ֥ים שְׂמֵחָ֗ה הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃
verses.en: Who maketh the barren woman to dwell in her house As a joyful mother of children. Hallelujah.
